title: TelemetryLogsRow
description: One log line in the canonical logs table over the full available span (03 §2.3). Written by Infralume; the key is not unique (identical rows are kept and ordered by all columns).

t_ns.description: Log time in ns since the Unix epoch (UTC), source time as given.

component.description: Normalised component (e.g. pod) name; equals service if unknown.

severity.description: Log severity; null when the source has none or an unknown severity string.

body.description: Log message, scrubbed of folder tokens only; multi-line stack traces stay in one row.

trace_id.description: Trace id of the log's span, as a string; null when the line has no span.

span_id.description: Span id of the log's span, as a string; null when the line has no span.

attrs_json.description: Canonical JSON of remaining attributes (e.g. unknown source columns), scrubbed.
